named-query.name: seriesDataEvent.findByNaturalId
named-query.query: FROM SeriesDataEvent WHERE exposureKeyId = :exposureKeyId AND date = :date

named-query.name: seriesDataEvent.findByRuleId
named-query.query: SELECT sd FROM SeriesDataEvent sd, RuleInputEvent ri WHERE ri.rule.id = :ruleId AND sd.exposureKeyId = ri.exposureKeyId AND sd.date = :date

named-query.name: seriesDataEvent.findByWildcard
named-query.query: SELECT sd FROM SeriesDataEvent sd, ExposureKeyEvent ek WHERE LOWER(ek.name) LIKE :name AND ek.type IN ('N', 'Y') AND sd.exposureKeyId = ek.id AND sd.date = :date

named-native-query.name: exposureKeyEvent.findByRuleId
named-native-query.query: SELECT ek.*, ri.name, ri.output_type, ri.output_key_id FROM series_data_key ek, amax_rule_input ri WHERE ri.rule_id = :ruleId AND ek.key_id = ri.key_id

named-native-query.name: exposureKeyEvent.findByWildcard
named-native-query.query: SELECT ek.*, NULL name, NULL input_type, NULL output_key_id FROM series_data_key ek WHERE LOWER(ek.key_name) LIKE :name AND ek.key_type IN ('N', 'Y')
